subject.title: WhatsApp: Backfill missed messages after reconnection

question: Should WhatsApp reconnect recovery attempt provider-side history backfill for monitored chats, emit only explicit gap warnings when Baileys emits no event, or keep the current bounded append-only behavior?
rationale: The remaining gap affects privacy, replay bounds, read receipts, delayed replies, and live-provider reliability, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent WhatsApp recovery policy.

options.title: Design bounded backfill plus warnings
options.body: Add monitored-chat, deduped, live-proven backfill where provider history is reliable and warn when the gap cannot be recovered.

options.title: Warn only first
options.body: Avoid replaying history for now and make reconnect health/logs clearly report that messages may have been missed when no event arrives.

options.title: Keep append-only recovery
options.body: Declare current main's bounded Baileys-delivered append handling to be the intended scope and close remaining provider-side backfill work after that decision.

recommendation.title: Design bounded backfill plus warnings
recommendation.body: Add monitored-chat, deduped, live-proven backfill where provider history is reliable and warn when the gap cannot be recovered.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete co-authored the current partial fix and posted the latest maintainer-visible note explicitly leaving this issue open for provider-side recovery policy.
